elsewhere.note: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some…
He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God…
and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.
It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”
For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God…
No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.
The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.
